title: bWalletX site theme (/.well-known/bwalletx-theme.json, v2)
description: What bWalletX looks like on this site's approval sheets once the user has connected. Colours #RRGGBB only; images same-origin (logo <= 64 KB, cardArt <= 256 KB; png, jpeg, webp, gif, svg); file <= 8 KB. The wallet also enforces contrast: text >= 4.5:1 on bg and surface (else swapped for black/white or refused), accent >= 3:1 on bg (else refused). The wallet's origin strip, amounts, recipients and Approve/Deny are never themed.

image.description: A path ('/brand/logo.png') or an https URL on the same origin as this file.

name.description: Plain words; no links, markup or addresses.
